limitations: This is a gap report, not an automatic completion gate.
reviewPerformed acknowledges actual bounded review; missing runtime or acceptance evidence is stated separately, not a blanket claim that nothing was audited.
Endpoint handlerPermissionFunctions/storageMethods/declaredResponses are clues, not full role/side-effect/output audits.
Feature references do not replace explicit per-layer implementation, users, issues/PRs and test mapping.
Screen state tokens require semantically inspecting the control and executing its state; column presence alone is weak evidence.
